description: Advisory mapping from skill name to the SDLC phases in which it is intended to run. Consumed by skill self-checks and documentation. Hook-level path enforcement lives separately in hooks/scripts/phase-policy.json.

init.description: Project bootstrap — runs exactly once at the start of REQUIREMENTS.

prd-quality-analyzer.description: Scores PRD testability and surfaces ambiguity; only meaningful before DESIGN.

business-rule-validator.description: Extracts and validates business rules; depends on approved PRD.

architecture-validator.description: Validates proposed architecture against domain policies and invariants.

test-strategy-planner.description: Produces scenario-set.md and test-strategy.md from the PRD.

regression-test-runner.description: Runs the test suite and computes pass rate.

mutation-test-runner.description: Generates mutations and computes mutation score.

coverage-analyzer.description: Rolls up coverage to requirement level; enforces P0 zero-uncovered rule.

cross-run-consistency.description: Runs the same test N times to detect flake.

observability-analyzer.description: Parses HAR, console logs; detects anomalies. Read-only.

release-decision-engine.description: Aggregates all quality signals into GO/CONDITIONAL/BLOCKED.

learning-loop-engine.description: Consumes historical reports to detect patterns. Read-only.

consensus-orchestrator.description: Multi-AI review; can run at any point on any artifact.

consensus-arbiter.description: Reads a consensus session's reviewer suggestions and emits diff-first patches — never writes to source directly (Sprint 15-F).

apply-arbiter-patch.description: Operator-in-the-loop patch applicator. Shows diff preview, asks for confirmation, applies via `git apply`, optional --run-tests (Sprint 15-G). Doc-only patches pass through the phase-write-guard in earlier phases.

consensus-specialist.description: Sprint 17-E dispatcher. Reads currentPhase and forks the matching phase-specialist agent (prd-rewriter/design-spec-refiner/adr-author/test-strategy-refiner/coverage-gap-filler/runbook-editor) to produce one deep-rewrite diff-first patch. Offered alongside consensus-arbiter from the orchestrator's NEEDS_REVISION / HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED follow-up.

status.description: Reports current phase and pending work. Read-only.

advance.description: Sprint 17.1 wrapper around sdlc_advance_phase MCP tool. Validates target phase, parses optional humanOverrideNote for HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED advances, surfaces exit-criterion failures with remediation suggestions.

quality-gates.description: Sprint 18-F. Runs lint + typecheck + unit-tests from vibeflow.config.json.tech.* and auto-satisfies `quality.gates.passed`. Pairs with consensus-orchestrator (which satisfies `code.reviewed` on APPROVED commit review) to unblock DEVELOPMENT → TESTING advance without manual MCP calls.

deploy-verifier.description: Sprint 18-G. Post-deployment smoke test: CI pipeline status (dev-ops MCP) + endpoint curl + observability health dashboard. Auto-satisfies `deployment.verified` + `health.checks.passed`. Writes the consensus-needed marker so `consensus.deployment.approved` still flows through multi-AI review.

traceability-engine.description: Maps requirements to test scenarios and source code.

arch-guardrails.description: Validates changes against architectural rules before commit.

checklist-generator.description: Emits review checklists (PR, release, feature sign-off).
